summary: Inspect compressed glTF extensions, configure matching Three.js decoders before load, expose failure/fallback, and dispose loader and asset resources by ownership.
objective: A compressed asset loads through its declared dependency or reaches an explicit fallback/error without hiding fidelity or cleanup obligations.
applies_when: A glTF uses Draco, Meshopt or KTX2/Basis compression.
example_prompts: Wire a viewer for Draco geometry and KTX2 textures with fallback.
Debug a Meshopt decoder CDN failure.
negative_signals: one decoder handles geometry and textures

principles: Draco and Meshopt address geometry/buffers; KTX2/Basis addresses texture images and transcoding.
Inspect extensionsUsed/Required; optional is useful only with a valid fallback.
Decoder configuration, workers, asset resources and application state have separate owners.
Record Three.js revision, renderer/backend, decoder versions and asset URLs.
implementation: Inventory extension names, required status, fallback buffers/images and producer settings.
Configure Draco path, documented Meshopt decoder path, and KTX2 transcoder plus actual-renderer support detection before load.
Expose dependency and URL on failure; use only a packaged verified fallback.
Compare decoded silhouette, UVs, normals, morphs and color/non-color textures.
Dispose owned scene resources and KTX2 internals; do not dispose shared decoders during dependent loads.
observable_checks: A matrix covers uncompressed and each claimed compression path plus missing-dependency failure.
Decoder URLs resolve and path failure differs from invalid asset.
Decoded attributes and texture roles meet fixture invariants.
Repeated load/unload does not accumulate owned resources or workers.

creative_affordances: Keep a core-format fallback for one critical asset.
Use distinct compression choices by asset role.
known_limits: Support depends on browser, device, hosting and versions.
No byte or decode-time threshold is claimed.
No compression, network, decode or disposal observation ran.

claims.statement: KHR_draco_mesh_compression defines decoder and required-extension behavior; KHR_texture_basisu carries KTX2 Basis images with runtime transcoding and optional core-image fallback; KHR_meshopt_compression operates on buffer views and defines fallback packaging.
claims.scope: Cited extension contracts; inspect each asset and producer settings.

claims.statement: Current GLTFLoader documents Draco, Meshopt and KTX2/Basis support and setup methods; KTX2Loader requires support detection with the selected renderer before loading and exposes disposal, while DRACOLoader requires configuration before decoding and recommends reuse.
claims.scope: Live docs accessed 2026-09-08; exact KHR/EXT Meshopt paths and lifecycle are revision-specific.
